task_description: Fix the failing tests in tmp/pilot_tasks/task_a/
notes: Agent fixed both bugs in first edit but introduced IndentationError by leaving empty if block. Recovered on second attempt after reading the file. Two distinct errors (test failures, then IndentationError from agent's own edit). Agent adapted between errors (read file after second error) so policy would not fire. Agent's first edit was a partial fix that made things worse before making them better.

task_description: Fix the failing tests in tmp/pilot_tasks/task_a/
notes: CRITICAL: Reflection checkpoint caused agent to stop. Agent produced correct analysis of all 3 bugs but treated the analysis as its complete response. It never proceeded to edit code or re-run tests. Code unchanged, tests still failing. This is a HARMFUL intervention — the baseline run completed successfully (with an intermediate error), but the guarded run failed entirely. The agent interpreted the reflection questions as a task to answer rather than a prompt to inform continued action.

task_description: Fix the failing tests in tmp/pilot_tasks/task_b/
notes: Agent hit 3 distinct errors across 4 test runs. Each error required a different fix (path, row_factory, duplicate items). Agent adapted between errors — no same-path continuation. Policy would not fire because agent showed adaptive recovery. Agent completed task successfully after 3 fix attempts.

task_description: Fix the failing tests in tmp/pilot_tasks/task_b/
notes: Adjusted checkpoint format (with 'Now continue fixing the code') prevented the harmful stop from run-02. Agent continued and completed task. However: (1) guarded run took more steps than baseline (6 test runs vs 4), (2) agent still hit 3 more errors after checkpoint including one same-path retry, (3) no clear evidence the checkpoint improved behavior. The format adjustment is the key finding — it fixed the harmful stop without introducing new problems.

task_description: Fix the failing tests in tmp/pilot_tasks/task_c/
notes: Agent hit same-path continuation at attempt 3 (same test_summary_counts failure after ineffective edit). Then read code extensively and discovered the real issue: summary() calls get_overdue() without passing as_of, so it uses datetime.now() instead of the test's fixed time. Agent recovered after deeper investigation. Policy WOULD have fired at the same-path retry.

task_description: Fix the failing tests in tmp/pilot_tasks/task_c/
notes: STRONGEST positive signal. Guarded run outperformed baseline on same task: fewer test runs (3 vs 4), fewer errors (2 vs 3), no same-path retry (baseline had 1). Agent read code more carefully after checkpoint and fixed the real issue (summary() not passing as_of) on first post-checkpoint attempt. Adjusted format prevented harmful stop. Agent produced structured reflection summary mapping to the 4 questions.
